# Open and closed models compared

<!-- Generated by `cd backend && go test ./internal/compose/aicert/ -run TestTheOpenVsClosedPageIsPublished -update-open-vs-closed` from the certification payload, the committed records and the price sheet; do not edit by hand. -->

This page sets the open-weight model setups beside the closed ones, with Gemini as the standard. It answers two questions: how many Margince AI features each setup carries, and what one run of each costs. Where a model is hosted is a later question, and nothing here measures it. The grades come from [ai-certification.md](ai-certification.md), which explains how each is earned.

## The setups side by side

| Setup | Weights | Ready | Usable with care | Not reliable yet | Not measured | Cost of one run of each feature | Against Gemini |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Google Gemini | closed | 28 | 9 | 1 | 0 | $0.0666 | 1.0× |
| Anthropic Claude | closed | 34 | 3 | 0 | 1 | $0.2525 | 3.8× |
| OpenAI GPT-6, through OpenRouter | closed | 19 | 3 | 3 | 13 | $0.0246 (28 of 38 features priced) | 0.4× |
| Gemma 4 you could run yourself, through OpenRouter | open (Gemma 4) | 22 | 6 | 9 | 1 | $0.0140 (37 of 38 features priced) | 0.2× |
| Open models from OpenAI and Mistral, through OpenRouter | open (gpt-oss) with Mistral on the upper tiers | 12 | 8 | 15 | 3 | $0.0307 (35 of 38 features priced) | 0.5× |

**Cost basis.** One run is the mean tokens that feature's test cases used, priced at the list price in [`pricing.go`](../../backend/internal/modules/ai/pricing.go): input and output only, no cache discount. It compares models on equal work. It is not a forecast of a bill, because a real workspace calls the features in a different mix.

## How to read the comparison

- **The judges differ.** A second model scores answer quality, and each family was scored by its own judge. Compare the grades with that in mind, and trust "tries right" in [ai-certification.md](ai-certification.md) most, because a mechanical check decides it.
- **A feature with no price is left out of the total**, and the table says how many. A setup that cannot carry a feature at all reads "Not measured".
- **Open weights are measured through a broker here.** The grade belongs to the model, and the serving, speed and price of a host you run yourself are separate measurements.
